fields.climate: temperate, but varies with altitude; cold, cloudy, rainy/snowy winters; cool to warm, cloudy, humid summers with occasional showers
fields.terrain: mostly mountains (Alps in south, Jura in northwest) with a central plateau of rolling hills, plains, and large lakes
fields.farm: milk, sugar beets, wheat, potatoes, pork, apples, barley, beef, maize, grapes
fields.exports: gold, packaged medicine, vaccines, nitrogen compounds, base metal watches
fields.industries: machinery, chemicals, watches, textiles, precision instruments, tourism, banking, insurance, pharmaceuticals
fields.languages: German (or Swiss German) (official) 62.1%, French (official) 22.8%, Italian (official) 8%, English 5.7%, Portuguese 3.5%, Albanian 3.3%, Serbo-Croatian 2.3%, Spanish 2.3%, Romansh (official) 0.5%…
fields.religions: Roman Catholic 34.4%, Protestant 22.5%, other Christian 5.7%, Muslim 5.4%, other 1.5%, none 29.4%, unspecified 1.1%
fields.legal: civil law system; judicial review of legislative acts, except federal decrees of a general obligatory character
fields.military: every Swiss man 18-30 is obligated to serve in the military or the alternative civilian service; women can serve on a voluntary basis…
